A selected list of projects, learning resources, and community initiatives that reflect my work in research data services, AI-enabled research workflows, open scholarship, and researcher engagement.

## Tools & Resources I've Built

### Open Science Knowledge Check

A self-assessment quiz on open science and scholarly publishing, built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) and Observable JS. It helps researchers gauge and build their understanding of open-science concepts at their own pace.

[Try the quiz](https://bellaratmelia.github.io/os-knowledge-check/){.btn .btn-outline-primary role="button"} [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/bellaratmelia/os-knowledge-check){.btn .btn-outline-secondary role="button"}

### Introductory R for Social Sciences

An open, self-paced course website for teaching R to social-science and humanities researchers, built in Quarto and taught at SMU since 2023.

[View the course](https://smu-libraries.github.io/r-socsci/){.btn .btn-outline-primary role="button"} [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/smu-libraries/r-socsci){.btn .btn-outline-secondary role="button"} [Earlier materials](https://bellaratmelia.github.io/introductory-r-socsci/){.btn .btn-outline-secondary role="button"}

*More workshop and teaching materials are available on my [GitHub](https://github.com/bellaratmelia).*

## Initiatives & Events I've Led

### FORCE11 (ongoing) & FORCE2026

- Vice President of [FORCE11](https://force11.org/), an international community advancing open scholarship, research communication, and e-research.
- Co-chaired the organising committee for FORCE2026, the community's flagship conference.

### AI for Research Week 2024

https://library.smu.edu.sg/sites/library.smu.edu.sg/files/banner-image/Banner_AI_Week24v02_04v.png{fig-alt="Banner for SMU Libraries AI for Research Week 2024" width="35%"}

- Led a team of seven in organising AI for Research Week 2024, defining the event scope, managing logistics, and coordinating speaker recruitment.
- Co-facilitated two hands-on workshops:
  - https://ink.library.smu.edu.sg/ai_research_week/Programme/Programme/3/ — guiding participants through real-time transcription using the Whisper API.
  - https://ink.library.smu.edu.sg/ai_research_week/Programme/Programme/2/ — demonstrating tools such as Elicit, SciSpace, Connected Papers, ResearchRabbit, and Undermind.ai for literature discovery and research workflows, with Aaron Tay and Ooi Kooi Cheng.

[Visit project website](https://library.smu.edu.sg/AI4ResearchWeek#programme){.btn .btn-outline-primary role="button"}

### Generate Your L(AI)brary Hackathon 2023

https://library.smu.edu.sg/sites/library.smu.edu.sg/files/library/newsEvents/Hackathon2023/Banner_HackV04b_RG.png{fig-alt="Banner for SMU Libraries Generate Your L(AI)brary Hackathon 2023" width="35%"}
